# Response.send() method

Writes the response body. Given a plain string by [HttpProtect.textMiddleware()](/api/http-protect/latest/http-protect.httpprotect.textmiddleware/) and a JSON string by [HttpProtect.jsonMiddleware()](/api/http-protect/latest/http-protect.httpprotect.jsonmiddleware/)<!-- -->; never called by [HttpProtect.middleware()](/api/http-protect/latest/http-protect.httpprotect.middleware/)<!-- -->, which answers with no body at all.

**Signature:**

```typescript
send(...args: any[]): any;
```
